To help you with cases where tasks take shorter than expected, we recommend reporting them during the task itself. When you are working on the annotation tool, on the top right corner you will see the “Report a problem” option. When you click on it, you will find an option called “Shareable link” this is the TV (Task Viewer) link. You can copy and submit this link to us.
 
Additionally, you can fill out the form whenever you feel a particular task is taking more time than expected, and we will review and assist you accordingly.
If you believe the warning may be due to an excessive number of longer tasks (high TPT), short tasks (low TPT), please fill out the following form to provide us with the links of those tasks. If we determine that the warning was unfair, we might waive it, but links for shorter tasks will not be taken into consideration. We request you to provide us the TV links through the form as we can address your concern on priority.
https://forms.office.com/r/tYqMvMpUwL?origin=lprLink
